IDENTIFY the commits on the 'feature' branch (including commit D and commit E) and the commits on the 'main' branch (including commit B).

SHOW the conflict markers that would appear in config.py during the rebase, using the standard <<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>> format.

INCLUDE the changes from the non‑conflicting commit E on line 20 of config.py in the final resolved file.
